$comment: The source of truth for the service marks Basalt bundles for an architecture card (DECISIONS 292, 2.4 and 2.5). One entry a mark. forms names which file draws on light grounds and which on dark ("swapped": the light file with its one fill swapped, as swap says). ink is each form's ink that meets the ground (the contrast test reads it). changes are which of 2.3's three were applied: stripped (what does not draw), fitted (the view box set to the artwork's bounds), swapped. viewBox is the fitted box per form, worked out once by fit.mjs and recorded here, so generating is the same on every machine. A mark is removed by deleting its entry and its source file; nothing else names it. Run node packages/react/marks/generate.mjs after an edit. unofficial: true marks a drawing that is not the owner's own file (DECISIONS 297: the owner asked for a mark on these even where it is not an official logo); its edits list every change made to the fetched file before the pipeline's own, and both files are in source/ with their hashes. Batch C (DECISIONS 301, 303) added more AWS Resource icons, Azure, Google Cloud and Kubernetes marks, and unofficial tile-removed AWS service icons (DECISIONS 297: Bedrock's rule). A multi-colour file (Azure, Google Cloud) is measured on its principal ink: the colour most of its drawing is nearest to (drawn at 128px, each opaque coloured pixel assigned to the nearest hex in the file), and where two or more are within 5 points of the largest share, the weakest of them. The contrast test reads one ink a form, so a multi-colour mark whose principal ink is under 3:1 on a ground has floorException (DECISIONS 303): its ink and the ratio on each ground under 3:1, and the test names every such mark and holds it to those values, so no other mark can slip under. The file's other fills are in the owner's palette, listed in the entry's departures.
